contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

A complete, Roman, struck or hammered, copper alloy, nummus or AE4 contemporary imitation or barbarous copy. Obverse: Unidentifiable. Inscription: Illegible. Reverse: Two soldiers holding two standards. Inscription:(GLORIA EXERCITVS). Minted in Britain by provenance. Reece period 17. The coin is in fine condition with some wear but extensive corrosion with all edges broken down. There is a heavy encrustation especially on the obverse with obliterated details. This coin is likely to date to 330-340AD. Ref.
